arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Edwin Kneedler argued the agency had no discretion to deny certification to eligible Mexican trucks.
He stated the trucks were eligible under the President's lifting of the moratorium.
He emphasized the trucks were willing and able to comply with statutory standards.
David Weissglass argued Congress gave the agency important choices about safety before trucks cross the border.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: The DOT wants the Court to confirm it had no discretion to deny certification to eligible Mexican trucks.
Public Citizen wants the Court to uphold the agency's authority to limit truck entry based on safety concerns.
